profile.reading: The registry operator name Centersquare and the domain centersquaredc.com resolve, via a same brand redirect, to csquare.com, indicating Centersquare and Csquare are current names for the same operator; this registry separately lists a Csquare operator record as well. The operator own site states it runs 80 colocation data centers across 30 markets, totaling 3.5 million square feet of space and more than 500 megawatts of power capacity, serving over 2,000 customers and more than 200 network and technology service providers, and describes itself as having operated for over 20 years, implying founding in the early 2000s. Its confirmed markets include Northern Virginia, Chicago Illinois, Phoenix Arizona, the Dallas Fort Worth area of Texas, Seattle Washington, the New York and New Jersey metro area, and Atlanta Georgia, matching every state where this registry carries a Centersquare facility. The company is headquartered at 3100 Olympus Boulevard, Suite 510, Coppell, Texas. No detailed founding history, prior company names, ownership structure, or building specific address and MW figures for this particular row were confirmed in available sourcing this session.

profile.research_note: This operator name, Centersquare, is a predecessor brand for the same Brookfield-owned colocation platform now operating as Csquare (uid d01580f9, see that row for full corporate lineage and sourcing). centersquaredc.com now 302-redirects to csquare.com. reading:
Centersquare is a predecessor brand name for the same Brookfield Infrastructure-owned colocation platform that now operates as Csquare. Brookfield launched the Centersquare brand in April 2024 to combine two companies it had acquired, Cyxtera, bought out of Chapter 11 bankruptcy for $775 million in a deal completed January 2024, and Evoque Data Center Solutions, which Brookfield had formed in 2019 from AT&T's divested data center assets. The company has since rebranded again, and centersquaredc.com now redirects to csquare.com.

This registry keeps this Centersquare row intact rather than deleting or merging it into the current Csquare row, per this assignment's rule against deleting registry data, and cross-links it as a duplicate_of the canonical Csquare entry, uid d01580f9, where the full corporate lineage, ownership, and 2026 IPO filing detail are recorded. Reconciling which of the 17 facilities tracked under this Centersquare row belong to the same physical buildings as facilities tracked under the separate Cyxtera or Csquare operator rows in this registry is left to the facility-level research phase of this assignment, not resolved here.

The registry tracks these 17 Centersquare-named facilities across seven states, Arizona, Georgia, Illinois, New Jersey, Texas, Virginia, and Washington.

sources.title: Data Center Dynamics, Brookfield combines Cyxtera and Evoque under new Centersquare brand
